acceptanceCriteria:
AppShell exposes meaningful semantics and a clear accessible name where required.

Loading, empty, error, disabled, and focus states are documented where applicable.

krigsvoldNotes: Use precise alignment and restrained surfaces; keep errors helpful and actionable.

name: Article
summary: Read a substantial saved specification with a title, metadata, section navigation, context, and a coherent text measure.
acceptanceCriteria:
The article has an accessible name associated with its title.
A single source supplies identical content in both families.
Headings, links, lists, tables, code, and long text reflow in light and dark modes.
Context reflows ahead of the body on narrow screens.
Print styling retains the saved content and removes interactive navigation.
martletNotes: Use a broad editorial heading, generous rhythm, serif body text, and a related context panel to the right.
krigsvoldNotes: Use an aligned metadata band, a precise left context rail, and a compact sans-serif reading column.

name: ErrorSummary
summary: Explain validation or operation failures, link field errors to their controls, and offer a clear recovery action.
acceptanceCriteria:
Errors are announced as an alert with an accessible title.
The caller can focus the summary through its native div ref.
Activating a field link moves keyboard focus to the named control or focusable group.
Failures preserve the entered draft and expose a recovery action when available.
Long errors and links wrap at 320 CSS pixels in both light and dark modes.
martletNotes: Group errors in an editorial panel with a strong top rule and generous spacing; keep recovery near the explanation.
krigsvoldNotes: Use a compact aligned panel with a precise leading rule; keep field links and recovery actions in reading order.

name: Pagination
summary: Navigate bounded pages of a saved collection with native previous and next buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Previous and next use native buttons; boundaries and pending states disable movement. The named navigation announces page position, retains keyboard semantics, wraps at narrow widths, and consumes real review queue results.
martletNotes: Roomy editorial spacing separates a visible page position and secondary actions.
krigsvoldNotes: Aligned controls and tabular page numerals clarify bounded movement.
migration: Experimental controlled page, pageCount, onPageChange, disabled, label, native nav props/ref. No embedded fetching, routing, or focus movement.
